notes:
Summary: Respondly Economics is a fast-growing CX automation vendor (internal ticketing + multichannel bot). Heavy focus on cost-efficiency — they operate at high volume and want predictable unit economics. Primary ask: high-volume chat deflection (reduce live-agent handoffs) while keeping per-deflection cost below target. Key constraints: EU data residency for 40% of traffic, SOC2 required, prefer VPC peering for Dedicated or Private.

Call notes / quotes: - 'We can tolerate occasional lower-quality replies on simple deflection flows, but agent-assist must be high precision.' - 'Cost is king: we need a path to $0.01 or lower per deflected chat (net cost target based on current staffing savings).'

Workload & technical requirements: - Traffic profile: average 75k messages/day, peak 8k concurrent chat sessions during promos; batchable patterns on FAQs and knowledge-base lookups. - Use-cases: deflection (bot-first for simple intents), ticket summarization (post chat), agent-assist (context windows up to 8k tokens), tool-calling to update CRM/Ticket system. - Latency targets: deflection path median < 120ms, 95th < 300ms; agent-assist < 250ms 99th for interactive flows. - Throughput: need to sustain steady-state 400 reqs/sec and absorb spikes 2-3x via burst capacity.

Model & inference preferences: - Prefer open models (Llama-family or similar) with quantization to INT8/4 for cost savings. - Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, KV prefix caching) and quantization profiles. - Fallback strategy: high-quality model for agent-assist + cheap quantized variant for deflection; automatic routing by policy.

POC plan & success metrics: - 4-week pilot: integrate via Redwood Hosted API or Dedicated trial; ingest 60k real anonymized transcripts. - Metrics: deflection rate uplift, mean tokens per session, cost per deflection, latency SLO compliance, ticket escalations saved. - Economic target: demonstrate >30% reduction in cost-per-ticket vs current provider and reach target net cost per deflection <= $0.01 (esp for FAQ flows).

Integrations & ops: - Integrations: Zendesk, Twilio, internal ticket DB, Snowflake for analytics. - Observability required: token-level billing, per-route latency, fallback counts, prompt set regressions. - Retention: 90 day convo retention for evaluation; longer retention negotiable.

Open questions & blockers: - Does Redwood support per-customer model pinning inside Dedicated? (client asks for deterministic fallbacks). - Procurement wants final pricing with burst terms and SLA. - Security needs HSM/KMS integration and EU residency proof.

Next steps: - Provide detailed batching/quantization cost projection (Ethan to run workload sim). - Schedule security deep-dive with infra + security (requested by 2025-02-20). - Confirm pilot onboarding timeline and support hours.

Links: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive; Fireflies call id above. Short-term ask from AE: carve out demo slot to show batching + cache impact on cost (15-20min).
notes_summary: Cost-sensitive, high-volume CX automation vendor focused on chat deflection and agent-assist. Wants pilot to prove batching/caching + quantization reduce unit economics while meeting latency SLOs. Security and procurement are primary blockers.
